# Fal 3D character roster — build an interactive 3D character selector

💳 **Paid API required** — Selected by Skill Harbor — short listing (the repo states no license, so no content is reproduced): @fal-ai-community's end-to-end recipe for shipping a polished, multi-character 3D web experience. Per character it generates a stylized full-body image (FLUX.2 / GPT-Image-2), converts it to a rigged animated GLB (Meshy v6, with curated animation IDs — idle, alert, dances), creates a color-locked companion creature, extracts a per-character PBR floor (basecolor/normal/roughness/metalness), and renders a looped video background (Seedance) — all packaged into a single static HTML page with a Three.js scene featuring palette swaps, mirrored reflections, breathing animations and a CREATE-YOUR-OWN flow for visitors. Honest caveats: the fal.ai API is metered — about $1.20 per curated character (roughly $12 for a 10-character roster); the final bundle is 25–35 MB of compressed GLBs.
